stories.title: Manturov notes strong Indian interest in SJ-100, Il-114-300 aircraft
stories.summary: The Russian first deputy prime minister also said that a prototype of a high-speed electric train jointly produced by India and Russia will be assembled by the end of this year, after which serial production will begin
article_sentences: There is strong interest in Russian civilian aircraft in India, Russian First Deputy Prime Minister Denis Manturov said at a meeting of the Russian-Indian Intergovernmental Commission on Cooperation.
"We are also working on joint projects in civil aircraft manufacturing.

At the beginning of this year, we presented the import-substituted SJ-100 aircraft and the upgraded Il-114-300 turboprop at the Wings India international air show, and they attracted strong interest from Indian airlines," he noted.
Manturov also said that a prototype of a high-speed electric train jointly produced by India and Russia will be assembled by the end of this year, after which serial production will begin.
According to him, industrial cooperation plays a key role in ensuring the technological sovereignty of Russia and India.
"In line with this approach, a flagship project in transport engineering is steadily progressing - the development and production of Vande Bharat electric trains.
A prototype of the electric train is expected to be assembled at a facility in Maharashtra by the end of this year and, after undergoing testing, will enter mass production," he said.
Indian airlines have indicated demand for up to 200 Russian Il-114-300 and SJ-100 aircraft, Vadim Badekha, CEO of the United Aircraft Corporation, part of Rostec, said in an interview with TASS.

stories.title: Imports of new EVs to Russia more than double in July to 1,200 — Autostat
stories.summary: Imports of new electric vehicles to Russia increased by 116.5% in July 2026 compared with the same month last year
article_sentences: Imports of new electric vehicles to Russia increased by 116.5% in July 2026 compared with the same month last year, reaching 1,200 units, Autostat CEO Sergey Tselikov said on his Telegram channel.
"In July, 1,210 new electric vehicles were imported into Russia, up 116.5% from July of last year," he said.
According to Tselikov, 1,500 new electric vehicles were imported into the country over the previous six months.
Meanwhile, total imports in January-July of this year amounted to 2,700 units, down 11.3% year on year.
The top 10 also included the Toyota BZ3 (82 units), GAC Aion V (57 units), BYD Yuan (28 units), GAC Hyptec HT (20 units), BYD Dolphin (13 units), Zeekr 001 (8 units), and Xiaomi YU7 (7 units).
